subject: angol
title: Summer jobs for students
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le, milyen munkát végeznek a fiatalok, hasonlítsd össze a két munkát, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire.

scenes.description: A seventeen-year-old boy is working at a busy fast-food stall on a beach. He is wearing a red cap and an apron, and he is serving chips and drinks to a long queue of hungry tourists. It is very hot and he is sweating, but he is smiling at a little girl who is paying.

Two teenage girls are working as helpers at a summer day camp for young children. They are sitting on the grass in a park with a group of seven-year-olds, playing a game with a big colourful ball. One of the girls is helping a crying child to stand up. Everyone is wearing the same yellow camp T-shirt.

prompts: What jobs are the young people doing?
Which job do you think is harder? Why?
Which of these jobs would you choose? Why?
followUpQuestions: Have you ever worked during the summer holidays?
What can students learn from a summer job?
Is it better to work or to relax in the summer? Why?
What would you spend your first salary on?

usefulPhrases.en: They are looking after small children.
You need a lot of patience.
You can earn some money and get experience.
I would choose the second job because ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Both pictures show young people doing summer jobs. In the first one a boy is working at a fast-food stall on a beach. He's serving chips and drinks to a long queue of tourists, and although it's very hot, he's smiling at a little girl. In the second picture two teenage girls are working at a day camp. They're playing a ball game with young children in a park, and one girl is helping a crying child to stand up. I think the first job is physically harder, because you have to stand all day in the heat. However, the second job needs a lot of patience. If I had to choose, I'd choose the camp, because I love children. I often look after my two little cousins.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What can students learn from a summer job?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think they learn how to work in a team and how to deal with people. They also learn how hard it is to earn money, so they spend it more carefully.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó közös bevezető mondattal kezd, leírja mindkét munkát, indoklással összeveti, melyik nehezebb, megmondja, melyiket választaná, és a rákérdezésre is kifejtett választ ad.
Szókincs: a munkához illő, pontos szavakat használ (fast-food stall, a long queue, physically harder, patience, look after, deal with people).
Nyelvhelyesség: az ellentétet az „although” és a „However” fejezi ki helyesen, a feltételezett választás második feltételes szerkezetben áll (If I had to choose, I'd choose …).
Érdemes megtanulni: „Both pictures show …”, „although it's very hot, …”, „If I had to choose, I'd choose …”, „how hard it is to earn money”.
